newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Astra stops animal tests at UK lab.
newsitem.headline: Astra stops animal tests at UK lab.

text.p: Swedish drugs group Astra said on Wednesday it would stop animal testing at a laboratory in Britain which it said was criticised in a television report.

Astra said that safety study tests on rats and mice at the Huntingdon Life Sciences lab, one of the largest in Britain, would be finished in mid-1997. It said the remaining tests would be continuously monitored by Astra staff.
"Astra's animal tests at Huntingdon have thereby ceased," the group said.
Astra said the lab had been criticised in a TV report shown on British and Swedish television and that it had decided to stop working with it.
